mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as businesses respond to increased demand.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as businesses face reduced output and potential earnings declines.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where INDPRO falls > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 200k & UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 200k & UNRATE falls > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as related industries benefit from increased activity.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST rises > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflationary pressure, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real income increases and the Fed may ease monetary policy.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL falls > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 rises > 2% YoY.
